calls.statement:
SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  SUM(rpt.net_sales) AS total_net_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT rpt.business_date) AS trading_days
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales AS rpt
JOIN dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = rpt.store_id AND s.is_current = true
WHERE rpt.store_id < 900
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY total_net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10
